heroHeadline: Russia Kills 10 in Kharkiv Missile Strike as Ukraine Launches Its Largest Drone Assault on Moscow in Years
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,636, two Russian Banderol cruise missiles hit a post office and shops in Pechenihy, Kharkiv Oblast, killing 10 and injuring 17, while a separate Tornado-S rocket strike injured five in Izium, including a 9-year-old boy. Ukraine answered with a second consecutive night of massive drone retaliation, launching over 620 drones at Moscow — its largest single strike on the Russian capital in years — following an ~600-drone assault two nights earlier; three people were injured in the Moscow region, including a 10-year-old girl. The escalation also saw a Russian mass strike on Kyiv, Kremenchuk, and Kryvyi Rih (7 killed, 51 injured, incl. the ArcelorMittal steel plant), a Ukrainian strike on Koloskovo village in Russia's Belgorod Oblast (6 killed), and a Spanish NATO F-18 shooting down a Russian drone that crossed into Romanian airspace near Galați — the fourth such incident in 2026. Russian military losses reached ~1,469,970 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff.
